title: Does Claude give Weekly Reset's out like candy?
author: Dangerous_Three_8506
selftext:
I was going to switch to Claude but ChatGPT keeps giving weekly reset's out like candy. I can't fathom switching with the freebies. I pay for the 20x and use it all then BAM a free reset every time for the past 40 days.

I have never run out of usage and I run Astra Extra-high/Ultra and Sol-Ultra for 10-12 hours a day on my project.

Does Claude support this? I still have 2 banked resets and who knows what they are going to give out before I even use both. We were just reset again today!!! In the past 40 days we have had around 7-10 resets (if you include your bank).

Is Claude like this?

I use GPT for all my studio tools and game.

comments.author: Sarcospam
comments.body: I used codex free and after 5 hours im locked for 30 days, feckin sucks

comments.author: re-skob
comments.body: no, Claude is stingy with the resets, but Opus 5.5 is less of a hog than Astra is. I keep running out of tokens by the middle of the week with Astra and even Sol 6 now, and the resets can't keep up.

replies.author: Dangerous_Three_8506
replies.body: Are you paying for 20x? I can't imagine an individual using the whole thing unless they are screwing around saying: "remake me GTA 5".

replies.author: HippieYoHippieYay
replies.body:
> unless they are screwing around saying: "remake me GTA 5".

Have you read the posts here? That's how a lot of users use frontier models, that and asking Astra if they should drive to the carwash.

replies.author: re-skob
replies.body: Yeah I have 20x, I have 3-6 threads going at any given time so it goes fast.

comments.author: recurrence
comments.body: Opus 5.5 SIPS tokens.  I had it running all day yesterday and it used like 5% of my weekly.  It’s amazingly cost effective.

comments.author: Key_River_9288
comments.body: Getting a bunch of resets for an inferior model wouldn’t be enough to make me stay. Anthropic has given me 3 resets in the last 4 months and only one is like a durable anytime reset, but with opus 5.5 being as good as fable at 40% less token cost than opus 5. Imma be honest i been trying to waste my tokens and I just cant get it done, they made opus 5.5 so darned smart and efficient I cant seem to find anymore reasons to conplain.
